verses.en: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD.
verses.pt: Sucedeu, pois, que no ano quatrocentos e oitenta depois de saírem os filhos de Israel da terra do Egito, no quarto ano do reinado de Salomão sobre Israel, no mês de zive, que é o segundo mês, começou-se a edificar a casa do Senhor.

verses.en: And the house which king Solomon built for the LORD, the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits.
verses.pt: Ora, a casa que e rei Salomão edificou ao Senhor era de sessenta côvados de comprimento, vinte côvados de largura, e trinta côvados de altura.

verses.en: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.
verses.pt: E o pórtico diante do templo da casa era de vinte côvados de comprimento, segundo a largura da casa, e de dez côvados de largura.

verses.en: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.
verses.pt: E fez para a casa janelas de gelósias fixas.

verses.en: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:
verses.pt: Edificou andares em torno da casa, contra a parede, tanto do templo como do oráculo, fazendo assim câmaras laterais ao seu redor.

verses.en: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.
verses.pt: A câmara de baixo era de cinco côvados, a do meio de seis côvados, e a terceira de sete côvados de largura. E do lado de fora, ao redor da casa, fez pilastras de reforço, para que as vigas não se apoiassem nas paredes da casa.

verses.en: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
verses.pt: E edificava-se a casa com pedras lavradas na pedreira; de maneira que nem martelo, nem machado, nem qualquer outro instrumento de ferro se ouviu na casa enquanto estava sendo edificada.

verses.en: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber, and out of the middle into the third.
verses.pt: A porta para as câmaras laterais do meio estava à banda direita da casa; e por escadas espirais subia-se ao andar do meio, e deste ao terceiro.

verses.en: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.
verses.pt: Assim, pois, edificou a casa, e a acabou, cobrindo-a com traves e pranchas de cedro.

verses.en: And then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.
verses.pt: Também edificou os andares, contra toda a casa, de cinco côvados de altura, e os ligou à casa com madeira de cedro.

verses.en: And the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying,
verses.pt: Então veio a palavra do Senhor a Salomão, dizendo:

verses.en: Concerning this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:
verses.pt: Quanto a esta casa que tu estás edificando, se andares nos meus estatutos, e executares os meus preceitos, e guardares todos os meus mandamentos, andando neles, confirmarei para contigo a minha palavra, que falei a Davi, teu pai;

verses.en: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.
verses.pt: e habitarei no meio dos filhos de Israel, e não desampararei o meu povo de Israel.

verses.en: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.
verses.pt: Salomão, pois, edificou aquela casa, e a acabou.

verses.en: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the cieling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.
verses.pt: Também cobriu as paredes da casa por dentro com tábuas de cedro; desde o soalho da casa até e teto, tudo cobriu com madeira por dentro; e cobriu o soalho da casa com tábuas de cipreste.

verses.en: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place.
verses.pt: A vinte côvados do fundo da casa fez de tábuas de cedro uma divisão, de altura igual à do teto; e por dentro a preparou para o oráculo, isto é, para a lugar santíssimo.

verses.en: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.
verses.pt: E era a casa, isto é, o templo fronteiro ao oráculo, de quarenta côvados de comprido.

verses.en: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.
verses.pt: O cedro da casa por dentro era lavrado de botões e flores abertas; tudo era cedro; pedra nenhuma se via.

verses.en: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
verses.pt: No meio da casa, na parte mais interior, preparou o oráculo, para pôr ali a arca do pacto do Senhor.

verses.en: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.
verses.pt: E o oráculo era, por dentro, de vinte côvados de comprimento, vinte de largura e vinte de altura; e o cobriu de ouro puro. Também cobriu de cedro o altar.

verses.en: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.
verses.pt: Salomão, pois, cobriu a casa por dentro de ouro puro; e estendeu cadeias de ouro diante do oráculo, que cobriu também de ouro.

verses.en: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.
verses.pt: Assim cobriu inteiramente de ouro a casa toda; também cobriu de ouro todo oe altar doe oráculo.

verses.en: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.
verses.pt: No oráculo fez dois querubins de madeira de oliveira, cada um com dez côvados de altura.

verses.en: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.
verses.pt: Uma asa de um querubim era de cinco côvados, e a outra de cinco côvados; dez côvados havia desde a extremidade de uma das suas asas até a extremidade da outra.

verses.en: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubims were of one measure and one size.
verses.pt: Assim era também o outro querubim; ambos os querubins eram da mesma medida e do mesmo talho.

verses.en: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.
verses.pt: Um querubim tinha dez côvados de altura, e assim também o outro.

verses.en: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.
verses.pt: E pôs os querubins na parte mais interior da casa. As asas dos querubins se estendiam de maneira que a asa de um tocava numa parede, e a do outro na outra parede, e as suas asas no meio da casa tocavam uma na outra.

verses.en: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.
verses.pt: Também cobriu de ouro os querubins.

verses.en: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.
verses.pt: Quanto a todas as paredes da casa em redor, entalhou-as de querubins, de palmas e de palmas abertas, tanto na parte mais interior como na mais exterior.

verses.en: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.
verses.pt: Também cobriu de ouro o soalho da casa, de uma e de outra parte.

verses.en: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.
verses.pt: E para a entrada do oráculo fez portas de madeira de oliveira; a verga com os umbrais faziam a quinta parte da parede.

verses.en: The two doors also were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.
verses.pt: Assim fez as duas portas de madeira de oliveira; e entalhou-as de querubins, de palmas e de flores abertas, que cobriu de ouro também estendeu ouro sobre os querubins e sobre as palmas.

verses.en: So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part of the wall.
verses.pt: Assim também fez para a porta do templo umbrais de madeira de oliveira, que constituíam a quarta parte da parede;

verses.en: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
verses.pt: E eram as duas partes de madeira de cipreste; e as duas folhas duma porta eram dobradiças, como também as duas folhas da outra porta.

verses.en: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.
verses.pt: E as lavrou de querubins, de palmas e de flores abertas; e as cobriu de ouro acomodado ao lavor.

verses.en: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.
verses.pt: Também edificou o átrio interior de três ordens de pedras lavradas e de uma ordem de vigas de cedro.

verses.en: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the LORD laid, in the month Zif:
verses.pt: No quarto ano se pôs o fundamento da casa do Senhor, no mês de zive.

verses.en: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.
verses.pt: E no undécimo ano, no mês de bul, que é o oitavo mês, se acabou esta casa com todas as suas dependências, e com tudo o que lhe convinha. Assim levou sete anos para edificá-la.
